text:
maya-support: Hey team — a customer hit a bunch of 401s after we upgraded them to the new SDK yesterday. They say server-to-server calls worked fine before, now everything from their app fails with {"error":"invalid_api_key"}. Repro steps:
1) Install new client v2.3.0
2) set API_KEY env from secrets manager
3) call /v1/complete with curl (example below)

curl -i -H "Authorization: ApiKey $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete

Any ideas?

sam-eng: Can you paste an exact header we saw in logs? Also does the same env value work from a simple node script on their server?

maya-support: Logs show header value (redacted) starts with: 
Authorization: ApiKey 36613636623336653635643666373866...
(the customer pasted the full thing but it's long hex)

lina-se: hm that value looks like lowercase hex only (0-9,a-f). Our API keys are base64url strings (letters, digits, -, _). If their secret got hex-encoded somewhere it would double the length and be invalid. Do we have a log rule that rejects pure-hex keys?

ops-bot: server: auth.reject format_check failed: key_format=hex_detected length=128
request_id=rq_01GXYZ

customer-ops: Customer claims they stored the key in an HSM connector that returns raw bytes and their CI team hex-encoded the bytes to store in Vault. When they populated API_KEY from Vault they inadvertently used the hex string.

sam-eng: Ok that explains it. Quick repro: we ran: 
node -e "console.log(Buffer.from('6f6b...','hex').toString('base64url'))"
and the base64url decodes to a valid-looking key. If you set that decoded value as API_KEY the request succeeds.

maya-support: That matches customer. Their workaround was to decode the hex and re-insert the proper key into secret manager. They want to avoid rotating keys for 3rd-party integrations. Any guidance we can give them?

lina-se: Recommend they update the HSM->Vault pipeline to store base64url (or raw string) and add a short CI check: fail if env var matches /^[0-9a-f]{80,}$/i. Also advise them not to hex-encode binary secrets.

sam-eng: Support action: we flagged requests and confirmed they were rejected due to format. Created a short KB note: "hex-encoded API key causing 401" with repro and command to convert (node/python). Provided the decoded key to customer via secure channel and asked them to rotate if they prefer.

maya-support: Customer confirmed decode fixed decking their test environment. Will keep ticket open while they update pipeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
